full_judgment: 7. Mr. Md. Abdul Quadir Talukder, the learned advocate appearing for the petitioners has placed the revisional application, pleadings, evidence, exhibits, judgment and decree of the courts below and submits that the suit is barred by law and there is no cause of action to file this suit. He submits that Mia Raja Patwary was judgment-debtor in Title Suit No. 48 of 1981 neither MM Raja Patwary or his legal heirs preferred any appeal against the judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No. 48 of 1981 and as such judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No. 48 of 1981 is binding for all. He also submits that the plaintiffs did not take possession of the suit land on the basis of alleged deed being number 945 dated 31.10.1981 and as such the deed has not been acted upon. He further submits that the suit is not maintainable without prayer for recovery of khas possession. He submits that impugned judgment and decree passed by the appellate court is not a proper judgment of reversal as per Order 41 rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure and such the judgment and decree is not sustainable in law. He lastly submits that the learned Judge of the appellate court has traveled beyond the pleadings of the plaintiffs and he prayed for to make the rule absolute.
